article_title: Action Research in Urban Schools: Empowerment, Transformation, and Challenges
citation: Razfar, A. (2011). Action Research in Urban Schools: Empowerment, Transformation, and Challenges. Teacher Education Quarterly, 38(4), 25-44. https://eric.ed.gov/?id=EJ949874
title: NVivo qualitative software for organizing and coding action research data
description: The teacher-researchers were trained in the uses of NVivo qualitative software to assist them in organizing and coding their participatory observation field-notes, daily reflective journals, video tape-log summaries where applicable, recorded interviews, recorded focus group discussions, and material artifacts. The tool supported the iterative nature of action research across the two-year period.
requirements: Training in the uses of NVivo qualitative software

article_title: Novel high-quality and reality biomaterial as a kidney surgery simulation model.
citation: Kubo Taro, Takayama Tatsuya, Fujisaki Akira, Nakamura Shigeru, Teratani Takumi, Sata Naohiro, Kitayama Joji, Nakai Hideo, Iwami Daiki, Fujimura Tetsuya. (2022). Novel high-quality and reality biomaterial as a kidney surgery simulation model. PLoS ONE. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0263179
title: NVP-fixed kidney surgical training model with controlled water-reflux washing protocol
description: A surgical training model made from Göttingen Minipig kidneys fixed with N-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone and washed by water perfusion. The protocol is that "Kidney fixation was first refluxed with FA or NVP fixative for 1 hour in its bath, followed by permeation for 23 hours, and then the kidneys were refluxed with freshwater for 48 hours as the washing step." The model mimics fresh-kidney hardness and strength, supports blood-like fluid perfusion and electrocautery, and is used for partial nephrectomy simulation training.
requirements: Arteriovenous access for organ perfusion must be secured without damaging the vascular system during organ harvesting
constraints: Handling of undiluted NVP requires the same care as formaldehyde, though the protocol uses diluted NVP followed by water perfusion
target_learning_goals: renal tissue incision, resection, and ligation skills
examples: The study used 26 Göttingen Minipig kidneys: 4 for hardness measurements, 20 for strength measurement, and 2 for reflux tests.
